name: a_semis_supply
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Semis & supply chain.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
TSMC / Samsung / SK hynix / Micron / Intel news; wafer and memory (DRAM, NAND, HBM) pricing; chip supply/demand estimates; equipment orders; supply-chain reports (Nikkei, DigiTimes, TrendForce, CLSA); China chip probes and export-control actions.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **MU** / **Samsung Electronics** / **SK hynix** `[Memory & Interconnect]`
- Counterpoint Research reported second-quarter 2026 DRAM revenue shares of **Samsung 38%**, **SK hynix 25%**, and **Micron 24%**; SK hynix’s share fell from **29%** in the prior quarter while Micron’s rose from **22%**. (SBS, Oct. 2, 2026; publish time not stated)
- Micron reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of **$54.23 billion** and adjusted EPS of **$33.42** for the June–August period. (Seoul Economic Daily, Oct. 3, 2026; publish time not stated)
- Micron said **more than 75% of fiscal-2027 production volume** had already been secured through sales contracts and that memory and storage supply-demand conditions in **2027 and 2028** would be tighter than in 2026. (SBS, Oct. 2, 2026; publish time not stated)
- TrendForce forecast fourth-quarter 2026 conventional DRAM contract prices to rise **10%–15% quarter over quarter** and NAND flash prices to rise **15%–20%**. (Evertiq, Oct. 2, 2026; 15:14 ET)
- Industry sources reported September average fixed contract prices of **$26** for 8Gb DDR4 DRAM, up **4% month over month**, and **$30.61** for 128Gb 16Gx8 MLC NAND, up **0.44% month over month**. (Seoul Economic Daily, Oct. 3, 2026; publish time not stated)
- Micron’s fiscal-fourth-quarter gross margin was **86.8%**, versus **84.6%** in the prior quarter. (SBS, Oct. 2, 2026; publish time not stated)
- Hana Securities estimated quarter-over-quarter DRAM and NAND price increases of **15%** and **18%**, respectively, and projected HBM would account for approximately **15% of Samsung’s DRAM revenue** next year. (Seoul Economic Daily, Oct. 4, 2026; 00:00 ET)
- Samsung Electronics was scheduled to release preliminary third-quarter results on **Thursday, October 8, 2026**. (Aju Press, Oct. 5, 2026; 01:40 ET)

## **INTC** `[Semiconductors]`
- Supply-chain sources cited by DigiTimes reported that Intel planned to raise PC processor prices by approximately **10% beginning October 5, 2026**, reportedly the company’s third increase since late 2025. **[report]** (Startup Fortune, Oct. 3, 2026; 04:38 ET)
- The report did not identify the affected processor families, and Intel had not publicly confirmed the pricing change as of the article’s latest update. **[report]** (Startup Fortune, Oct. 3, 2026; 04:38 ET)

## **TSM** `[Fab & Foundry]`
- TrendForce reported that TSMC was scheduled to release third-quarter results on **October 15, 2026**. (TrendForce, Oct. 5, 2026; 04:47 ET)
- TrendForce cited a Central News Agency estimate that TSMC advanced-node prices could rise **5%–10%** next year, advanced-packaging prices **10%–15%**, and mature-node prices **3%–5%**. (TrendForce, Oct. 5, 2026; 04:47 ET)
- Commercial Times, citing the Culpium newsletter, reported that TSMC was exploring a potential Texas fab partnership connected with Elon Musk’s Terafab project; Musk said the discussions were preliminary. **[rumor][report]** (TrendForce, Oct. 5, 2026; 04:47 ET)
- TrendForce reported that TSMC A14 pilot production at Baoshan, Hsinchu, could begin as early as **first-quarter 2027**, based on a September Commercial Times report. **[report]** (TrendForce, Oct. 5, 2026; 04:47 ET)

## **Samsung Electronics** `[Fab & Foundry]`
- Counterpoint Research estimated Samsung Electronics held approximately **4%** of the global foundry market in the second quarter of 2026, ranking second behind TSMC. (Seoul Economic Daily, Oct. 1, 2026; 02:44 ET)
- Counterpoint Research estimated TSMC’s second-quarter revenue at **$40.2 billion**, representing approximately **42%** of the Foundry 2.0 market. (Seoul Economic Daily, Oct. 1, 2026; 02:44 ET)

## **ASML** `[Chip Equipment]`
- ASML was expected to report third-quarter results in **mid-October 2026**, according to TrendForce’s semiconductor earnings calendar. (TrendForce, Oct. 5, 2026; 04:47 ET)

## South Korea semiconductor exports `[Macro / Geopolitics]`
- South Korea’s September 2026 semiconductor exports reached a record level, with shipments reported as **more than triple** the year-earlier level. (Aju Press, Oct. 5, 2026; 01:40 ET)
